args.title: Freight Market Update - Combined Summary
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges are now tracked against weekly (rather than monthly) diesel price benchmarks.
- Companion analysis: shippers who diversified volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.

Source: blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight and insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion
